headline: Earnings per share edge higher on the quarter and year
summary_short: Synchrony's Q3 2026 EPS was $2.68, up about 3% from $2.61 in Q2 and about 7% from $2.51 a year earlier.
summary_long: EPS rose to $2.68 from $2.61 last quarter and $2.51 a year ago. The company's monthly credit statistics for September show period-end loan receivables of $103.3 billion, a 30+ day delinquency rate of 4.3% and a net charge-off rate of 4.7%.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. The Q3 2026 earnings release could not be located; the EPS figure is from the shard (Yahoo earnings chart) against SEC basic EPS priors, so basis may differ. Credit statistics come from the 8-K monthly exhibit, which covers September only.
